invariant.portable_principle: A semantic-duplication detector may surface a typed function-level lead only when its static evidence and uncertainty boundary are explicit; it must not call a lexical clone, caller/callee wrapper, dynamic behavior, or divergent policy a safe refactor.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Python keeps a scout-confirmed function triage pipeline. Its copied reference now requires end_line through all comparison artifacts, retires unused workflow/artifact inventory output, and renders uncertainty separately from rejection.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: One family-local Node command resolves a host-local TypeScript Compiler API from package.json, parses a named tsconfig, creates a Program/TypeChecker, resolves direct identifier calls, compares typed return/output shape, and writes final triage plus matrices.
explicit_non_goals: Protocol, class-method, framework, React, Node, ORM, or runtime semantics
Dynamic dispatch resolution or external consumer proof
Automatic consolidation, codemods, source mutation, or a guard
A shared Compiler API resolver platform

reference_repairs: Bundled a selected-skill stdlib Python inventory and made end_line required in definition/summary/prompt/candidate flow.
Retired workflow and artifact inventories from the runnable Python function path because no confirmation, rank, or report stage consumed them.
Changed Python rank/report output so uncertain scout verdicts remain a separate final triage category instead of being filtered into rejected.
Made the Python candidate collapse function-only to match the repaired reference contract.

known_false_positives: Matching return type and object fields can represent divergent behavior, so throw/try/await policy mismatch is rejected and runtime behavior remains human review.
Dynamic and declaration-only direct calls cannot establish behavior and are explicit uncertainty.
known_false_negatives: Expression-bodied arrows, nested functions, class methods, protocols, different output shapes, and semantic equivalence without the static output signature are deliberately omitted.
legitimate_similar_shapes: Caller/callee wrappers are rejected through resolved direct-call evidence.
Near-identical token pairs are rejected for find-duplication.
Protocol implementations and test doubles remain outside top-level function candidates.

agent_confusions: Same return shape is evidence for a lead, not a semantic equivalence proof.
Dynamic/declaration-only direct calls are intentionally uncertainty rather than clean output.
The TypeScript report is separate from the Python scout path and does not claim workflows or structural duplication.
repeated_work: map-subsystem supplied the accepted host-compiler, named-tsconfig, exclusion, symlink, and stock-closure patterns; they were copied locally without a shared runtime.

residual_risks: Static output-shape equality can over- or under-approximate behavior, so confirmed leads require human source/caller/runtime review.
Dynamic dispatch, external callers, methods, framework behavior, and different output shapes are deliberately unavailable.
The host must supply Node, a valid project-local tsconfig, and a package-local TypeScript compiler.
D6 independent non-context replay remains pending serial integration.
